validation.browserRecheckMeaning: Composite scoped case coverage, not a clean aggregate run: original7PASS/1FAIL/8not-run; offline-DB recheck0PASS/1FAIL/1not-run; explicit fresh-process rechecks retained. No timeout increase or runtime code repair; reliability gate stays open.
validation.intermediateUnitEnvironmentRepair: Initial all-unit run incorrectly enabled expansion for legacy four-package tests:126PASS/4FAIL. Correct environment gives130PASS/0FAIL without changing test expectations.
validation.nativeFullScopeMeaning: 74=70 new activities +4 shared;8=4 additive repairs +4 shared;12 regressions include exact saved-session/hash checks across all384 current HSK2–4 activities. These are execution counts, not distinct tests summed across runs.

native.methodology: Source package reads count readFileSync(package filename); full DB manifests count result.rows.manifest objects. These are IO-boundary body counts, not every allocation inside Zod. SQL timing is client wall time including decoding. First connection measured before first Today; all4requests share one bounded pool. No HTTP/GUI or cloud latency claim, no automatic retries. Old learner rows are not modified; dedicated synthetic owner only.

coldHttpAtFinalSize.limits: Direct HTTP observations allow90s to measure compilation; product15s/20s fetch and5s SQL limits are unchanged. Each record explicitly flags whether it exceeds its application fetch budget. Cold first process is not a fresh client against an existing server.

boundedInitialReusedCacheProbe.limits: Direct HTTP observations allow90s to measure compilation; product15s/20s fetch and5s SQL limits are unchanged. Each record explicitly flags whether it exceeds its application fetch budget. Cold first process is not a fresh client against an existing server.

today.limitations: Zero ordinary full-body reads is verified. Metadata index parsing remains corpus-sized, rejected pages can add work. HTTP200 within a90s observer does not pass unchanged15s/20s product budgets. ECONNRESET/aborted server logs remain observations, not an established root cause. No general SLA or cache/transport closure.
